Substantive of tsaraat (Lev 13:2-59; 14:3-57; Deu 24:8; 2Sa 3:29; 2Ki 5:3,6,7,27 (twice); 2Chr 26:19; etc.). 35 occurrences. Hyphenated. The Lev 13-14 priestly-diagnosed skin-condition. KJV traditional 'leprosy'; modern medical 'leprosy' (Hansen's disease) is not the same condition — the Hebrew tsaraat covers a broader range of skin-diseases including some affecting clothing and houses (Lev 14:33-53). 'Skin-disease' or 'leprosy' both have problems; concordant 'skin-disease' is more accurate.
